result.reason: The transition assistance largely reaches the preferred position, but the data-export deadline runs from Customer’s request rather than from expiration or termination, so it does not ensure export within 30 days of the triggering event. It also requires return and deletion of all Content upon termination of any single Service Option Attachment, potentially disrupting Content used under unaffected attachments and conflicting with the original clause’s preservation of those arrangements. The provision should distinguish termination of the entire Agreement from termination of an individual attachment and limit return/deletion accordingly. The margin comment does not cure these operative defects.
